checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Three separate square photorealistic images delivered

must.why: Same golden retriever look, ears, muzzle and coat in all three; the fireplace dog is slightly more orange.

must.item: Locations: sandy beach, snowy forest trail, cosy living room
must.why: Beach and living room are correct, but the forest is an autumn forest with no snow.

must.item: Dog naturally integrated with plausible scale, lighting, ground contact
must.why: Lighting and contact are good in all three. The autumn dog's rear legs are slightly odd.
No clothes and no text visible.

faults.what: The second scene is an autumn forest with no snow, but the brief called for a snowy forest trail.
The autumn dog's hind legs and body are slightly ambiguous and a bit short.
The fireplace dog's coat is more orange and deeper than the original.

summary: Three good photoreal golden retriever images came out, but the second is an autumn forest instead of the snowy forest trail required.
